purpose: Teach: 曲目/新曲/雑音/緻密/ロッカー/似顔絵/起こる/ちがい

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、コンサートの、絶対、曲目、絶対、楽しみよ
lines.en: Sho, I'm really looking forward to the concert setlist with you.
lines.style: Warm, inclusive tone. Speaking directly to him with genuine affection. Steady pace, no rush. The voice of someone who means what she says.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、ぼく、絶対、新曲、絶対、聴きたいよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I really want to hear the new songs at the concert.
lines.style: Eager but not loud. Leaning forward slightly in his voice. Genuine excitement that's still small and true to his quiet nature. Direct, sincere.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: メイ姉さんの、本気で、絶対、お部屋、絶対、雑音、絶対、なくて、絶対、勉強に良いのよ、翔くん
lines.en: My room is really quiet, Sho — it's good for concentrating on things like that.
lines.style: Gentle, offering. Slight pride in the fact that her space is useful to him. Warm undertone. Unhurried, like she's thinking as she speaks.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、ぼく、絶対、緻密、絶対、な絵、絶対、描いたよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I drew a really detailed picture the other day.
lines.style: Small but genuine pride in his voice. Not boasting — stating a fact he's a little pleased about. Quiet confidence. Slight smile underneath.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、お家の、絶対、ロッカー、絶対、ぼくの、絶対、お洋服、絶対、入れてあるわよ、翔くん
lines.en: I've got your clothes stored in the locker at home, Sho — everything's ready for you.
lines.style: Practical, capable tone. The assurance of someone who has thought ahead and taken care of things. Warm without being showy. Simple competence.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、ぼく、絶対、お母さんの、絶対、似顔絵、絶対、描きたいよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I want to draw a portrait of Mom.
lines.style: Tender wish underneath. Quiet but clear intention. The earnestness of a child who has thought of something he wants to make. Hopeful.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 地震が、本気で、絶対、起こる、絶対、と、絶対、ちゃんと、絶対、机の下に隠れてね、翔くん
lines.en: If there's an earthquake, Sho, make sure you hide under the desk right away, okay?
lines.style: Gentle but firm. The voice of someone who cares enough to be clear. Not alarming — practical. A small pause before the instruction, like she's making sure he hears her.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、ぼく、絶対、お友達と、絶対、性格の、絶対、ちがい、絶対、わかるよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I've noticed how different people's personalities can be from mine.
lines.style: Quietly thoughtful. The voice of a six-year-old noticing something genuine about the world. Earnest, a little uncertain, seeking confirmation. No performance.
